entities.label: NVIDIA
entities.overview: NVIDIA builds the hardware and software layer behind modern accelerated computing. Originally a gaming graphics company, its CUDA ecosystem turned GPUs into general-purpose engines for artificial intelligence.

timeline.label: Founded by Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem
GeForce 256 marketed as the world's first GPU
CUDA platform released - GPUs become programmable
Volta architecture targets deep learning workloads
Generative AI boom drives record data-center demand
Ranks among the most valuable companies worldwide

entities.label: OpenAI
entities.overview: OpenAI researches and deploys large language models. Its ChatGPT product brought conversational AI to hundreds of millions of users and reshaped public expectations of software.

timeline.label: Founded as a non-profit AI research lab
GPT-3 demonstrates few-shot learning at scale
ChatGPT launches - fastest-growing consumer app of its time

entities.label: QUANTUM COMPUTING
entities.overview: Quantum computing exploits superposition and entanglement to process information in ways classical machines cannot. Practical advantage remains work-in-progress, targeted at chemistry, cryptography and optimization.

timeline.label: Peter Shor's algorithm threatens classical encryption
Google claims first quantum computational advantage
Logical qubit error correction milestones reported

entities.label: THREE.JS
entities.tagline: 3D in the browser - the engine behind this very interface
entities.overview: Three.js is an open-source JavaScript library that renders interactive 3D graphics through WebGL. This DIXOR concept build runs entirely on it.

timeline.label: ES modules era begins; ecosystem expands rapidly
Powers countless product configurators, maps and spatial UIs
